source: ZXNAME0000XZ and ZXNAME0001XZ are usually discussed as reduced-precision floating-point formats rather than post-training quantization schemes. ZXNAME0002XZ sits closer to the boundary: modern training/inference systems use scaling recipes around ZXNAME0003XZ tensors, so it is often discussed in the same low-precision toolbox as quantization.
zh: ZXNAME0000XZ 和 ZXNAME0001XZ 通常被讨论为降低精度的浮点格式，而不是训练后量化方案。 ZXNAME0002XZ 更接近边界：现代训练/推理系统使用围绕 ZXNAME0003XZ 张量的缩放配方，因此通常在与量化相同的低精度工具箱中讨论它。
